notes:
Summary: Lantern Harbor is a developer-first code search product used internally and sold to enterprises. Primary objective: replace existing Elastic-based search for code + docs with a semantic stack that supports reranking at scale.

Key technical constraints: large embedding corpus (~15M vectors now, projected 40M within 12 months), frequent re-indexing (hourly deltas for active repos, daily full rebuild), low tail latency target for interactive code search (p99 <= 120ms). Cost sensitivity: wants clear unit economics — willing to trade GPU cost for 10-20% accuracy uplift on reranker.

Preferred architecture and asks from call:
- Want private deployment inside customer VPC for regulatory customers; also evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput on public cloud.
- Needs SSO/SAML (Okta) + SCIM for provisioning and audit logs forwarded to customer's SIEM.
- Looking for support for cross-encoder rerankers (GPU-backed) and ability to fall back to CPU-based lightweight reranker during bursts.
- Incremental indexing + partitioning by repo/team; ability to prune old vectors and control retention per project.

POC specifics agreed:
- Redwood to provision dedicated GPU pool + VPC peering for PoC. Customer will provide 1M-vector extract (mix of code and markdown).
- Two reranker variants to test: distilled cross-encoder (faster) vs full cross-encoder (higher quality) — measure latency, QPS, token cost.
- Measure end-to-end cost/query with batching, KV cache hints, and route policies (canary to cheaper model).

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need search to feel instant for devs — sub-150ms is the bar or adoption drops." — Eng Manager, Lantern Harbor
- "If we can prove per-query cost is predictable, we can justify Dedicated commit." — Head of Procurement

Open items / Risks:
- Need IdP SAML metadata and test account.
- Legal asking for data residency attestations for EU customers (we store code of EU customers).
- Reindexing pipeline complexity: they want a recommended approach (incremental streaming vs full rebuild) and help sizing commit slots.

Links: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive (linked above). Jira tickets filed for infra questions (INFRA-1124).
technical_summary: Scale: 15M vectors today -> 40M in 12 months; Query load: target 1k-10k QPS. Latency SLO: p50 ~30-60ms, p95 ~80-100ms, p99 <=120ms for retrieval+rerank. Reindex cadence: hourly deltas, daily full. Rerank strategy: hybrid recall (sparse + dense) then cross-encoder rerank top-50. Cost sensitivity: mid-high; wants unit cost projections. Security: SAML/SCIM + audit logs + KMS. Deployment preference: private VPC or Dedicated. Why Redwood: runtime performance, model routing, and observability for token-level cost breakdown.
po_c_goals: Validate end-to-end latency and per-query cost for 1M vector subset; demonstrate reranker quality lift vs baseline; verify SSO + network connectivity; produce TCO projection for 12/24 month scale.
